descriptions.d10d_flags_empty_801aae7c: Flag-table emptiness test; the first argument is unused. Returns 1 when the owner record (+100) has a zero count at +24, 0 when the table (+96) has a zero length at +24, and otherwise 1 only if no flag byte at table +32 (one per entry, unsigned length) is set. Partial observed views; full types and sizeof unknown.
